camel_example: aliyun eci DescribeImageCaches --region cn-hangzhou --Tag.1.Key imc --ImageMatchCountRequest 3 --MatchImage.1 'registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/eci_open/nginx:1.15.10-perl' --ImageCacheId 'imc-bp195erqe9o2pb090000' --ResourceGroupId 'rg-2df3isufhi380000' --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF20000 --Image nginx --SnapshotId 's-2zec5oj8e1yhxijt0000' --ImageCacheName testcache --ImageFullMatch true --Tag.1.Value test --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Limit 20
description_en: Queries the details of one or more image caches
description_zh: 调用DescribeImageCaches批量查询镜像缓存信息
kebab_example: aliyun eci describe-image-caches --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-cache-id imc-bp195erqe9o2pb090000 --image-cache-name testcache --snapshot-id s-2zec5oj8e1yhxijt0000 --image nginx --resource-group-id rg-2df3isufhi380000 --tag Value=test Key=imc --match-image registry-vpc.cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/eci_open/nginx:1.15.10-perl --limit 20 --next-token AAAAAdDWBF20000 --image-full-match true --image-match-count-request 3 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeImageCaches

parameters.help_en: The ID of the image cache
parameters.name: image_cache_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the image cache
parameters.name: image_cache_name

parameters.help_en: The ID of the snapshot that corresponds to the image cache
parameters.name: snapshot_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the image cache belongs
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The tags that are attached to the image cache
parameters.help_zh: 镜像缓存绑定的标签信息
parameters.name: tag

parameters.help_en: The container images that are used to query the matched image caches. You can specify up to 100 images
parameters.help_zh: 指定容器镜像，用于查询最佳匹配的镜像缓存，最多100个
parameters.name: match_image

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return
parameters.name: limit

parameters.help_en: The token that is used for the next query. You can obtain the token from the \`NextToken\` parameter in the response to the previous API call
parameters.help_zh: 查询凭证（Token），取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken参数值
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform an exact match for the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.
parameters.help_zh:
是否完全匹配容器镜像。    
在配置了MatchImage取值的情况下，进一步过滤查询结果
parameters.name: image_full_match

parameters.help_en:
The number of image caches that exactly match the container images.
This parameter is used to further filter the query results when \`MatchImage\` is specified.
parameters.help_zh:
完全匹配容器镜像的镜像缓存个数。    
在配置了MatchImage取值的情况下，进一步过滤查询结果
parameters.name: image_match_count_request
